title: DEPHYRIER Fons Aut Silentium (Source Or Silence)
style: source-or-silence pulse 92 bpm trilingual EN LA FR DEPHYRIER signature no-fabrication-rule disk-traceable cold-pad spoken-latin ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every batch traces back to a source on the disk
No fabrication no embellishment no fictional risk
If the source goes silent the lane stops clean
No invented row no narrative seen

[Pre-Chorus — Latin]
Fons aut silentium nihil aliud
(Source or silence nothing else)
Fabula non admittitur in tabulario
(Story is not admitted in the ledger)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER source or silence nothing in between
Fons aut silentium fuente o silencio
(Source or silence source or silence)
La source ou le silence rien d'autre
(The source or the silence nothing else)

[Verse 2]
Linear COR Slack activity Drive folder Cursor post
Each a real surface that the verse can host
When the source dries up the batch waits patient
Not a fabricated line not a phantom statement

[Bridge — French]
Sans source pas de couplet pas de refrain
(Without source no verse no chorus)
Le silence vaut mieux qu'un mensonge serein
(Silence is worth more than a calm lie)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER source or silence chosen
Fons aut silentium fuente o silencio
DEPHYRIER la source ou rien d'autre
